page.overview:
Who is Strawberry Ice?

Strawberry Ice is a female Earth pony with a light blue coat, two-tone pink mane and tail, light pink eyes, and a cutie mark of two yellow bows. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise. She has speaking roles in Made in Manehattan and Fake It 'Til You Make It.__TOC__

Strawberry Ice first appears in the season four episode Power Ponies during a sweeping shot of Maretropolis. She later makes multiple appearances in Manehattan in Rarity Takes Manehattan. In Pinkie Pride, a filly Strawberry Ice appears in Cheese Sandwich's flashback during Cheese Confesses.

Strawberry Ice later appears in Trade Ya! when Pinkie Pie auctions off Princess Twilight Sparkle's books at the Rainbow Falls Traders Exchange. She also appears three times in Equestria Games spectating the titular event at the Crystal Empire as Tirek and Discord drain unicorns of their magic at an auditorium in Twilight's Kingdom - Part 1.

Strawberry Ice appears multiple times in Manehattan The Gift of the Maud Pie, attends the grand opening of Rarity For You in The Saddle Row Review, and appears at Gladmane's Las Pegasus resort in Viva Las Pegasus.
